questions: Have you noticed drooping of one or both eyelids?
Do you see double, especially when looking up or when tired?
Do these eye or facial symptoms worsen with prolonged use and improve after rest?
Do you have difficulty swallowing or choke on food or liquids?
Does your speech become slurred, nasal, or weaker after talking for several minutes?
Do you have weakness in your neck, arms, or legs?
Do you have difficulty raising your arms, climbing stairs, or rising from a chair?
Have you had any shortness of breath, especially when lying down?
Have the symptoms fluctuated noticeably during the day?
Do you have numbness or tingling in your face or limbs?
Do you have weakness on one side of your face, including difficulty closing one eye or smiling?
Do you have a severe new headache, scalp tenderness, jaw pain while chewing, or vision loss?
Have you recently had an infection, surgery, vaccination, or significant illness?
Have you started any new medication or taken sedatives, muscle relaxants, or antibiotics recently?
